requirements.title: Command Line Interface Implementation
requirements.description: Develop a CLI tool supporting all core operations including profile management, task execution, run monitoring, and artifact retrieval. Include proper error handling and help documentation.

validation.notes: All core operations accessible via CLI

requirements.title: Unsupported remote runner targets fail closed
requirements.description: The global --node selector must never be silently ignored: when Agent Manager has no governed remote runner route, it must fail explicitly instead of returning local runner results.

validation.notes: Rejects a non-empty --node target before runner commands can be treated as local execution.

requirements.title: Operator management dashboard
requirements.description: Where the management dashboard is available, Agent Manager may present bounded task, run, workflow, supervision, and health state with safe operator actions.

validation.notes: Verify bounded projections and guarded actions across dashboard domains when implemented
